registration.statement: Insertion replaces one X-Z adjacency by X-Y and Y-Z while conserving all three carriers. Extrusion is its exact inverse. Migratory insertion is the exact composition of migration and insertion, transforming metal-migrant and metal-inserted adjacency into retained metal-inserted and migrant-inserted adjacency. Elimination retains both eliminands and centres while generating the product adjacency and a held unsaturation, ring or carbene boundary.
